name: comment-thread
title: Comment thread
description: Plain-text comments by default, with optional renderBody for safe Markdown, avatar, author and Timestamp, plus a reply composer (Textarea + Button, ⌘/Ctrl+Enter posts). renderBody receives the raw comment; use a safe renderer such as @gntik-ai/chat Markdown (without allowHtml). Bodies are untrusted: never inject raw HTML. composerHint overrides the catalog hint and remains the textarea’s accessible description.
author: gntik-ai
